text:
Maya (CS): Quick capture from today's onboarding call with NorthBridge — three signals that could affect renewal next quarter.

Maya (CS): 1) Per-route billing visibility: they can't map costs to product routes, asking for a per-route toggle in Console.
Maya (CS): 2) Embedding freshness: reindexing takes ~24h; they want near‑real‑time updates or a webhook when new embeddings are available.
Maya (CS): 3) Failover formatting: when we fallback to a cheaper model variant the JSON outputs can be malformed, causing downstream parsing errors.

Maya (CS): Onboarding otherwise ok, but these three are blocking two execs and may stall usage ramp. Can we triage priority & owners? @Liam @Aria

Liam (PM): Thanks Maya. Can we get severity vs effort for each? My quick read: 1) high pain + medium effort, 2) medium pain + high effort, 3) high pain + low effort.

Aria (Prod): I agree on 3) as a quick win we should patch. Need an example of the malformed output to reproduce.

Maya (CS): Example pasted below (redacted):

```json
{"input":"Summarize sales call","model":"rwd-3b","response":"null
{\"summary\":\"...\"}"}
```

Maya (CS): They see broken JSON when fallback to rwd-3b happens — missing streaming delimiter and inconsistent envelope.

Carlos (CSE): I can add a small compatibility layer that normalizes variant outputs into our expected envelope. Low risk; can prototype this sprint.

Liam (PM): Proposed triage:
- Per-route billing visibility -> P0 for renewal cohort (needs product + console scope)
- Fallback formatting -> P1 (Carlos to prototype this sprint)
- Embedding freshness -> P2 (longer infra work, add to Q2 roadmap)

Maya (CS): Perfect. Can someone create tickets and link them to the onboarding playbook? We also promised the customer a short update by EOD.

Carlos (CSE): Creating tickets now. Draft titles: `CS-8123 Per-route billing toggle`, `CS-8124 Fallback output normalization`, `CS-8125 Embedding near-real-time pipeline`.

feedback-bot: Created tickets CS-8123, CS-8124, CS-8125 and linked them to this thread. :white_check_mark:

Liam (PM): I'll add acceptance criteria and a tentative rollout window. Maya — want me to draft the customer-facing note or do you?

Maya (CS): Please send the note, thanks. I'll include immediate workarounds for embeddings and timeline.

Aria (Prod): Thanks — assigning dev owner for CS-8124 to @Carlos and marking CS-8123 to scope with infra.

Maya (CS): Updating the onboarding tracker and tagging renewal risk. :rocket:
